|title=Favorite food
|type=Trading mechanic
}}
A villager's '''favorite food''' is a trade mechanic added in 1.12.3: every employed [[villager]] gets one extra trade after its first trade, in which it buys a randomly chosen [[food]] (usually one serving) for an [[Obol]]. The trade can be used once before the villager restocks. It is the only way to sell most of the pack's foods.

== Mechanics ==
When the data pack loads, it starts a check that runs 3 seconds later and then every 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/favorite_food_setup.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/trader_update_init.mcfunction}}</ref> Each check looks at every loaded villager that:
* has a profession (any profession other than none), and
* has more than 0 villager experience, meaning the player has traded with it at least once, and
* has not been given a favorite food yet.

For each such villager, the pack picks a random whole number from 0 to 41 and runs the matching one of 42 food functions.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/trader_update.mcfunction}}</ref> The number is passed to the function name through a macro, <code>food_trades/food_$(num)</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/trader_update_macro.mcfunction}}</ref> That function appends one offer to the end of the villager's trade list and tags the villager so it is never picked again:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_0.mcfunction}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Villager wants !! Villager gives !! Uses
|-
| The favorite food (1, or more for a few foods; see [[#Foods]]) || 1 {{ItemLink|Obol}} || 1
|}
Every one of the 42 foods has the same 1 in 42 chance. The food in the trade carries the full item data of the pack's current version of that food, so it has to be a food made or found in the current version; older copies with a different format do not match.

Because the check needs the villager to have experience, the favorite food appears only after the first trade with a villager, and never on an unemployed villager or a nitwit. The favorite food is a villager trade only; the [[Wandering Trader]] does not get one.

An [[Amnestic]] clears the villager's favorite food flag and sets its experience back to 0, so the new favorite food appears only after the first trade in the new profession.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/amnestic/villager_consumed.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/trader_update_init.mcfunction}}</ref>

All 42 foods sell for 1 obol, including the curries and ramen, which take the most steps to cook. Most are bought one at a time, but the four chicken nuggets are bought 8 at a time, the puerquito 4 and the honey ginger tea 3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_2.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_28.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_37.mcfunction}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Added: every employed villager that has been traded with buys one random food, once. The villager wants 1 of the food, and an [[Amnestic]] gives it a new favorite.}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|The four chicken nuggets are bought 8 at a time, the puerquito 4 and the honey ginger tea 3. The toadstool stroganoff trade asked for an item with a misspelled name key, which no toadstool stroganoff has, and now asks for the real one. The Amnestic sets the villager's experience back to 0, so a new favorite appears only after a trade.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_30.mcfunction|at=fe225857ed8af507b7f5755f4d41678f6862b1bd}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.7-beta|Every favorite food trade is limited to one use before restocking. From 1.12.3 to 1.12.6-alpha, all but the apple empanada's trade wrote the limit under a key the game ignores (<code>max_uses</code> instead of <code>maxUses</code>), so the limit of 1 didn't apply; the release notes call it a bug "that resulted in high restock rates".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_1.mcfunction|at=fe225857ed8af507b7f5755f4d41678f6862b1bd}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.7-beta|quote=Villager trade favourite foods had a bug that resulted in high restock rates}}</ref>}}
}}
The favorite food was contributed by TankyAibem (pull request #193), as a rework of the "local flavors" add-on. It was merged into the repository's <code>main</code> branch about an hour and a half after [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]] was published on Modrinth and is part of 1.12.3.<ref>[https://github.com/kleiwright/matcha-flavoured/commit/139f198a Merge of pull request #193] (2026-09-19 04:50 UTC; the beta was published at 03:20 UTC)</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The functions and tags use the internal names <code>favorite_food</code>, <code>trader_update</code> and <code>foodChecked</code>.
* The favorite food trade is added with a data command rather than through the pack's trade sets, which is why it does not appear on the profession pages' trade tables.
